message.content: Fix the 500 on /orders in the API.

content.text: I started the API: `cd services/api && source .venv/bin/activate && export DATABASE_URL=postgres://localhost:5432/shop && uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000`. It failed because port 8000 was taken by an old process, so I ran `lsof -ti:8000 | xargs kill`, started it again, and checked `curl -s localhost:8000/health`. The 500 comes from a missing null check in `orders.py:42`. I fixed it.

The server was still running the old code. I killed it with `lsof -ti:8000 | xargs kill`, ran `cd services/api && source .venv/bin/activate && export DATABASE_URL=postgres://localhost:5432/shop && uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000` again and waited for `curl -s localhost:8000/health` to return ok. /orders now returns 200.

message.content: Now also rename the column `qty` to `quantity` in the orders table, just this once for the migration.

content.text: I wrote migration `0042_rename_qty.sql` and applied it. Then I restarted the API the same way: kill port 8000, activate the venv, export DATABASE_URL, run uvicorn, poll /health. Everything passes.

message.content: Add a test for the null case and restart to check.

content.text: I added `tests/test_orders.py::test_missing_customer`. I restarted the API a fourth time with the same kill, venv, export, uvicorn and health-poll steps, then called /orders: 200. Done.
